notes: Kit backs itself up on its own now, nightly, without being asked.
Once a week it takes the newest backup and proves it actually restores, into a throwaway copy that is thrown away.
Health says when you were last backed up and when that backup was last proven, so "probably fine" is never the answer.

Restoring says plainly what it cannot bring back. Anything that needed a password or a key has to be reconnected, and Kit now tells you that instead of letting it look connected and quietly do nothing.
A big import drains steadily, oldest first, and the health card can tell a stuck one from a busy one.
Your editor connection is tighter: Kit's owner tools listen only where they should, and older setups move themselves to key-based sign-in.
Charts, labels and the email Kit sends you finally share one set of type sizes.
